meta.description: Q-diversity: rank-one scalar drive, three arms with matched attachments (hetero/homo nonlinear, linear), held-out affine and 1-D fits, within-cluster descriptors, vs b and alpha; then planted multi-block inputs.

config.eval_split: first half fits, second half scores

multi.planted: z_k block scalars; spline fit uses the best single z_k

fields.rank1[].<key>[k]: value at b_grid[k] for (arm, alpha, seed)
fields.frac_in_multi: fraction of neurons in multi-member components
fields.affine_err_mean/max: held-out relative MSE (dimensionless, MSE / variance) of the affine fit from the full input, mean/max over neurons
fields.spline_err_mean/max: held-out relative MSE of the 1-D fit from the planted scalar (multi: best single z_k)
fields.deff_w, rank_w, proto_err_w, deff_resid_: per multi-member component, averaged weighted by size: d_eff (dimensionless), numerical rank (sv > 1e-3 sv_max), held-out relative MSE of member ~ a + c*prototype, d_eff of the members' residuals after that regression, mean RMS distance to prototype (response units)
fields.strength[]: rank-one drive at default (b, alpha), potentials (klo, khi) in [(1.0, 0.0), (3.0, 0.0), (10.0, 0.0), (30.0, 0.0), (0.0, 3.0)] x threshold spread sigma_t in [0.35, 0.7, 1.4]: same measures
fields.uncoupled: same neuron measures at W = 0 (before learning)
fields.presets.<arm>: seed 0 at default (b, alpha): component labels, response curves u_i(z) on z_grid (rows = neurons), thresholds t

meta.seed_streams: network attachments [seed,0]; thresholds [seed,3]; training bank [seed,1]; evaluation bank [seed,2]; random covariance presets fixed seed 12345
